existing_derivations.title: Turbulent Flow Near a Wall
existing_derivations.abstract: The von Karman constant κ ≈ 0.41 appears in the logarithmic law of the wall for turbulent boundary layers. Its value is determined empirically but dimensional analysis constrains the form.

z_squared_connection: No clear Z² connection found in literature
physical_meaning: Coefficient in logarithmic velocity profile of turbulent boundary layers
mathematical_path: Identify relevant physical quantities. Form dimensionless groups. Use Buckingham Pi theorem. Constrain form of constant.
required_assumptions: No new physics beyond SM at relevant scales
